newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close barely higher in thin dealings.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close barely higher in thin dealings.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed a dull session barely higher following sharp losses the previous session.
The most-active January contract remained supported above key 100.00 and closed up 0.10 to 101.35, having ranged from 101.75 to 100.25. The back months finished 0.70 to 0.05 firmer.

In fundamental news, consumption in Western Europe is seen growing by three to five percent annually for the next ten years, the president of the Brazilian Association of Citrus Exporters (Abecitrus), said today.
His comments were delivered to industry representatives at the Citrus Economists' meeting in New Orleans.
